summary: Exited at +54.75pts after the trade round-tripped down from a +72.25 local high with giveback hitting 67% on the active leg and all three turn detectors (KMDR, HA, PROPP) converging against the position simultaneously at 0m lag. Held through several earlier chop/pullback cycles (ER10 swinging 0.13-0.85, giveback spiking to 46-95% on small sub-legs) since price kept reclaiming new highs each time, but this frame was the first where signal convergence plus a fresh drop off a new high occurred together.
